title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION Case of Paata Burchuladze and political prisoners under the Georgian Dream regime
part_text: ‘urges the EU to maintain a coordinated response and reiterates its call for targeted sanctions and visa bans against those responsible for serious human rights violations, including Bidzina Ivanishvili, Irakli Kobakhidze, Shalva Papuashvili, Kakha Kaladze and other senior officials, as well as judges, prosecutors and law enforcement officials;’
